text:
Your biggest enemy isn't competition. It's a generic username.

Here's why:

A generic name is noise. You're invisible in 0.5 seconds.

A keyword in your username signals who you are before he even clicks.

One tag. One word. Something tied to what you actually do or what makes you stand out.

That one change is the difference between being found and being forgotten.
caption: Men who understand personal branding win before the conversation starts. Your name is the first test. Send this to a man who needs it today. #selfdevelopment #menshabits #mindset #discipline #successmindset
